Adhyaya

A practical management system designed to replace manual library registers and spreadsheets with a single dashboard for seats, students, subscription plans, payment tracking and monthly analytics.

Explore Project View Screenshots
Project Overview

Built for real library operations.

The application gives a library owner a central place to register the library, authenticate securely, configure plans and seats, assign students, monitor payment status and manage the monthly collection.

Problem

Small libraries often manage seat allocation, student details and monthly fees manually. That makes payment follow-up, seat availability and historical records difficult to maintain.

“One dashboard to know which seat is free, who is using it, which plan they have, and who still needs to pay.”
Core Features

What the system can do

🔐

Library Registration & Login

Owners can register a library with credentials and log in to access the management dashboard.

💺

Seat Management

Add seats, view their live state and manually mark seats available or unavailable when required.

👨‍🎓

Student Bookings

Assign students to seats with phone details and a selected subscription plan.

🗓️

Subscription Plans

Create plans such as Full Day, Morning or Evening with configurable timings and monthly fees.

💰

Payment Tracking

Track paid and unpaid students, monthly collection and pending fees from the dashboard.

📊

Monthly Analytics

Select a month and review student count, payment status, collection and pending amount for that period.

🔔

Payment Reminders

Identify students with pending fees and send the next available reminder from the pending-fee section.

✏️

Edit & Delete

Update student booking details, move a booking to another seat/plan, or remove records when needed.

🧾

Payment History

Open a student's details to review their payment history and understand previous payment activity.

Typical Workflow

From registration to monthly collection

1

Register

Enter library, owner, email, password and total seats.

2

Configure

Create subscription plans and add or manage seats.

3

Book

Assign students to available seats and choose their plan.

4

Collect

Mark monthly payments, review pending fees and use reminders.

Portfolio Takeaway

A practical CRUD + analytics project

This project demonstrates more than a basic form-based CRUD application: it combines authentication, seat allocation, time-based plans, booking management, payment status, monthly reporting, reminders and a responsive dashboard into one real-world workflow.
